name: heggria-taskflow
description: A declarative, verifiable graph of task nodes for coding-agent subagents — not a workflow you script, but a DAG you declare: statically verified before it runs, with dynamic fan-out, gates, isolated subagent context, and resumable runs. Runs on Pi and Codex. Zero deps.
